name: Stalk With The Earthmother
summary: Boarton Shadetotem sees a talent for subtlety in you and asks you to enter the Venture Company mine. He wants Seaforium Mining Charges taken from the mine’s supply carts.

sections.title: A Subtle Approach
sections.body: Boarton Shadetotem, in Thunder Bluff, believes you can work with subtlety. He gives you a mask and asks you to enter the nearby Venture Company mine. There, you are to take Seaforium Mining Charges from carts of blasting supplies and bring them back to him.

faq.q: Who asks me to enter the mine?
faq.answer: Boarton Shadetotem in Thunder Bluff asks you to enter the Venture Company mine.

faq.q: What am I looking for in the mine?
faq.answer: You are asked to take Seaforium Mining Charges from carts of blasting supplies.

faq.q: Why does Boarton give me a mask?
faq.answer: Boarton gives you a mask for entering the nearby Venture Company mine.

faq.q: Where is the Venture Company mine?
faq.answer: The mine is southeast of Thunder Bluff.

faq.q: Who are the supplies taken from?
faq.answer: The supplies are in the Venture Company mine.

angles.text: As a rogue, Boarton believes you have a talent for subtlety and asks you to enter the Venture Company mine.
